def move(terrain, start, duration_s, n_runs, seed):
    import numpy as np
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)

    N_STEPS = 60
    dt = duration_s / (N_STEPS - 1)  # seconds per step

    lat = np.full(n_runs, start[0])
    lon = np.full(n_runs, start[1])
    t = 0.0

    points = np.empty((n_runs, N_STEPS, 3), dtype=float)
    points[:, 0, 0] = lat
    points[:, 0, 1] = lon
    points[:, 0, 2] = 0.0

    # We model a northward ridge crest secondary trail route:
    # - Move roughly north (bearing ~0 rad), with small lateral noise to simulate ridge following
    # - Adjust step speed by Tobler hiking function using slope
    # - Use small lateral random perturbation to allow dispersion within trail zone

    # Precompute meters per degree
    m_lat = terrain.m_lat
    m_lon = terrain.m_lon

    # Walking parameters
    mean_bearing_rad = 0.0  # due north
    bearing_std_rad = np.deg2rad(5)  # small bearing noise in radians (~±5 degrees)

    # Lateral offset factor to keep walkers near ridge crest (smaller noise)
    lat_noise_deg = 0.00002  # ~2 meters latitude noise per step (small jitter)
    lon_noise_deg = 0.00002  # ~2 meters longitude noise per step lateral jitter

    for i in range(1, N_STEPS):
        # Sample bearing noise for each run around north
        bearing = mean_bearing_rad + rng.normal(0, bearing_std_rad, n_runs)

        # Calculate horizontal distance traveled in this dt based on slope and Tobler speed
        elev_now = terrain.elev(lat, lon)
        # Look slightly ahead along bearing and fixed distance (estimate slope)
        look_ahead_dist = 5  # meters ahead for slope gradient estimate
        lat_look, lon_look = terrain.offset(lat, lon, bearing, look_ahead_dist)
        # Clamp look ahead to terrain box
        lat_look, lon_look = terrain.clamp(lat_look, lon_look)
        elev_look = terrain.elev(lat_look, lon_look)

        d_elev = elev_look - elev_now
        d_horiz = look_ahead_dist

        speed = terrain.tobler_speed_ms(d_elev, d_horiz)  # m/s
        dist = speed * dt

        # Movement vector in degrees
        dlat = dist * np.cos(bearing) / m_lat
        dlon = dist * np.sin(bearing) / m_lon

        # Add small random jitter lateral to bearing direction to mimic trail variability
        dlat += rng.normal(0, lat_noise_deg, n_runs)
        dlon += rng.normal(0, lon_noise_deg, n_runs)

        lat += dlat
        lon += dlon

        # Clamp inside terrain box
        lat, lon = terrain.clamp(lat, lon)

        points[:, i, 0] = lat
        points[:, i, 1] = lon
        points[:, i, 2] = i * dt

    ok = terrain.inside(points[:, -1, 0], points[:, -1, 1])

    return points, ok
